summary: Merge, grow, and dominate the arena in Giant Rush! Epic fights await!
description:
GIANT RUSH is an action packed hyper casual fighting games with giants, monsters. deadly arena and monster duels. Jump on board, run, dodge through the obstacle track, merge blobs, grow stronger and battle against giant monsters in fighting games! 

In this hyper casual runner game, players take on the role of a heroic adventurer on a quest to defeat massive giants and collect valuable treasures in FIGHTING GAMES. 

BRAWL FIGHT with the giant monster, dodge the incoming attacks and take down the enemy in fighting games. Choose your strategy and lead your blob hero to victory in the epic battle! Build a strong blob runner warrior and crush your enemy in STICKMAN HERO FIGHTING GAMES. 

The FIGHTING GAMES also feature epic boss battles with massive giants that require strategy and skill to defeat. During these battles, the stickman hero must dodge the giant's attacks while launching their own attacks to weaken and eventually defeat the giant. 

An epic survival race! Collect and upgrade your blob hero, overcome all the obstacles and win the epic battle with the giant in fight games. Lead your STICKMAN HERO, collect and merge blob to get stronger in medieval combat games. Get a bigger and powerful warrior to clash against the giant king in brawl fighting games. 

Run, dodge through dangerous zones, merge blob hero to get stronger and reach the finish line in fight games! Brawl against the giant boss at the end of the run to WIN the brawl fight games. The giant boss throws hard punches, dodge the incoming attacks and punch back in brawl fight games. 

Gain experience as STICKMAN HERO face dangerous giant monsters in brawl games. Indulge in monster duels, face off giants in epic battle games. Go on castle raids, collect blobs and get bigger to brawl against giant monsters in sword fight games. Dodge the incoming attacks, swipe to hit back harder and destroy bosses in monster battle games.

Guide your blob runner on a dangerous track, your decisions will make the difference between victory and defeat! 

Game Features:
Run, Collect, Merge and Get Bigger! 
Race Through Dangerous Track. 
Rush Towards the Finish. 
Get Stronger to Face The Giant. 
Brawl Against Monsters. 
Win the Giant Race Challenge!
